verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions LoRA adapters, adapter loading, or serving multiple adapters on a shared base model. Running multiple models concurrently and hot-swapping models are related but different capabilities and earn no credit. The axis applies to a local LLM serving runtime, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
